description.en: Multi-member version of RemoveParty_Message: removes several party members in sequence, each with the standard SE-21 jingle and "sysmes-remove_party" message presentation and a BGM fade — a fixed-preset wrapper around RemoveParty_MessageEx.
Array of param IDs, one per member to remove.
Array of status-reset flags, one per member.
Optional; when true, removes members without locking their slot (defaults to false).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Remove several party members in sequence with the standard departure presentation
RemovePartyNum_Message(_rmv_num, _aParamID, _aStReset, _not_pt_lock);
